sanskrit_verse: धान्यं दशभ्यः कुम्भेभ्यो हरणे�भ्यधिकं वधः । शेषेष्वेकादशगुणं दाप्यस्तस्य च तद्धनम् ॥
transliteration: dhānyaṃ daśabhyaḥ kumbhebyho haraṇe 'bhyadhikaṃ vadhaḥ | śeṣeṣv ekādaśaguṇaṃ dāpyas tasya ca taddhanam ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When grain is taken from ten pots, the act exceeds mere killing; for the remainder, elevenfold restitution must be made, along with the original wealth.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is derived from the capacity to sustain life through sustenance
Causation arises from disruption of fundamental life-supporting resources
Capacity-based responsibility is measured by access to and control over essential commodities
Restoration logic demands proportional return of value plus surplus to correct imbalance
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of interdependence and correction of harm
executable_legal_axioms: IF a resource classified as 'life-sustaining' (e.g., grain) is unlawfully removed from a defined threshold unit (e.g., ten containers), THEN the act constitutes a violation exceeding ordinary harm categories.
IF a violation affects residual availability of essential goods, THEN the offender MUST compensate at eleven times the extracted value PLUS return of the principal amount.
IF restitution occurs, THEN public record MUST reflect completion of corrective alignment to restore systemic integrity.
supreme_court_application: In cases involving appropriation of essential public goods beyond a prescribed threshold, the Supreme Court shall apply this rule to establish liability not based on punitive models but on systemic restoration. The multiplier ensures that extraction causing scarcity is corrected through surplus return, aligning economic behavior with dharmic balance rather than individual deterrence.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This provision aligns with Nyaya through pramāṇa-based causality: the unlawful removal of grain disrupts sequential dependence chains (anupūrvaśaḥ). Responsibility is proportional—elevenfold return reflects the expanded consequence of disrupting foundational supply. There is no infliction of pain; the mechanism realigns consciousness through completion and compensation, ensuring future alignment with dharma.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Offender must publicly acknowledge the breach and execute full elevenfold compensation.
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Legal entity assumes stewardship until system equilibrium is verified.
Capacity Restoration Mechanism: Community oversight confirms reintegration of returned assets into circulation.
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Public ledger updated to reflect corrected balances and prevent recurrence.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law is established. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
